# Structured-data fixtures

Inputs for the structured path adapters: JSON extraction (D3), the
structured UI (D4), YAML continuity (D1), and a later YAML adapter.
Expected paths use the canonical Iara syntax of
`iara.features.structured.path` (D2), for example
`doc[2]::$["server.port"][0][""]`. Indexes are zero-based. JSON targets
belong to document 1.

Files are hand-written, except `deep_nesting.json` and `wide_array.json`,
which were generated once and committed. Inputs that need lines over 80
bytes (minified documents, raw keys over 4 KiB) must be generated by the
test that uses them.

## JSON

- `root_object.json`: nested objects, indexes 0, 9, and 10, key `"0"`
  versus index 0, empty containers. Expect
  `doc[1]::$["list"][10]["tenth"]`, `doc[1]::$["0"]`, and
  `doc[1]::$["nested"][0][0]["deep"]`.
- `root_array.json`: root array, so paths start with an index. Expect
  `doc[1]::$[1]["tags"][1]` and `doc[1]::$[2][0]`.
- `root_scalar.json`: root scalar. The only path is `doc[1]::$`.
- `literal_keys.json`: literal dots, brackets, empty keys, escaped quotes,
  backslash and solidus, `\u` escapes, a surrogate pair, escaped control
  and NUL, and a multibyte prefix before the target. `["server.port"]`
  differs from `["server"]["port"]`. Expect `doc[1]::$[""]`,
  `doc[1]::$["say \"hi\""]`, `doc[1]::$["slash/escaped"]`,
  `doc[1]::$["café"]`, `doc[1]::$["😀"]`, `doc[1]::$["tab\there"]`,
  `doc[1]::$["nul\u0000byte"]`, and `doc[1]::$["nested"][""][""]`.
- `invalid_strings.json`: keys that strict decoding rejects (lone high
  and low surrogates, invalid escape, raw tab, short `\u`). Those keys
  are source-only; `doc[1]::$["valid"]` stays complete.
- `duplicates.json`: duplicate `name` keys, and a duplicate ancestor `a`
  that makes both `b` children ambiguous. `"café"` and `"café"` are
  duplicates after decoding; the decomposed `"é"` is a different
  key (no normalization). `doc[1]::$["unique"]["a"]["b"]` stays unique.
- `multiple_values.json`: grammar recovery of three top-level values.
  Expect `doc[1]/root[2]::$["a"]` and `doc[1]/root[3]::$[0]`, never two
  targets claiming `doc[1]::$["a"]`.
- `empty_multiple_values.json`: `{} {}` on one line. Expect
  `doc[1]/root[1]::$` and `doc[1]/root[2]::$`.
- `comments.json`: line and block comments in objects and arrays.
  Comments never count as elements: `doc[1]::$["items"][1]` is
  `"second"`.
- `incomplete_unterminated.json`: unterminated string value while
  editing. `doc[1]::$["intact"]["x"]` stays complete.
- `incomplete_missing_value.json`: key without a value.
  `doc[1]::$["intact"][1]` stays complete.
- `incomplete_unclosed.json`: unclosed containers at end of file. Paths
  under `outer` are at best incomplete, never invented.
- `incomplete_key.json`: unterminated key between intact pairs.
  `doc[1]::$["ok"]["child"]` stays complete; the broken key never
  decodes.
- `error_elsewhere.json`: syntax error in an unrelated subtree.
  `doc[1]::$["good"]["path"]["to"]` and `doc[1]::$["also_good"]["k"]`
  stay available.
- `deep_nesting.json`: 130 alternating object and array levels, over the
  128-segment cap. The value `"bottom"` sits 130 segments deep: extraction
  stops at the cap and marks it incomplete, so `render` refuses with
  `incomplete`. A hand-built 129-segment target still yields `too_long`.
- `wide_array.json`: 2,100 elements, over the 2,048 sibling-visit cap.
  Exact indexes of the last elements may be unavailable; never guessed.

## YAML

Paths follow the written structure: no alias expansion and no merge
synthesis.

- `multi_document.yaml`: identical paths in documents 1 and 2; document
  3 is a root sequence. `doc[1]::$["server"]["port"]` and
  `doc[2]::$["server"]["port"]` stay distinct; `doc[3]::$[1]["name"]`.
- `literal_keys.yaml`: quoted dots and brackets, empty double- and
  single-quoted keys (duplicates of each other), a doubled single quote,
  escapes, key `"0"`, multibyte keys, and a plain key with spaces. Expect
  `doc[1]::$["server.port"]`, `doc[1]::$["it's"]`,
  `doc[1]::$["say \"hi\""]`, and `doc[1]::$["nested"][""][""]`.
- `duplicates.yaml`: duplicate keys and duplicate ancestors; `key` and
  `"key"` are the same key. `doc[1]::$["unique"]["a"]["b"]` stays unique.
- `anchors_aliases.yaml`: anchors, aliases, merge keys, and an alias
  cycle. `doc[1]::$["development"]["<<"]` is a source occurrence; no
  `adapter` key is synthesized under `development`.
- `comments.yaml`: comments between sequence items and pairs.
  `doc[1]::$["items"][1]` is `second`.
- `non_string_keys.yaml`: null, boolean, numeric, complex, and tagged
  keys, and a custom-tagged value with descendants. Those keys and their
  descendants are source-only; `doc[1]::$["1"]` is the quoted key.
- `scalar_styles.yaml`: multiline quoted explicit keys, literal and
  folded blocks, flow and block collections. Multiline keys stay
  source-only until folding is decoded. Expect
  `doc[1]::$["flow"]["b.c"][1]["d"]`.
- `root_sequence.yaml`: root sequence with a nested sequence. Expect
  `doc[1]::$[1]["tags"][0]` and `doc[1]::$[2][1]`.
- `incomplete.yaml`: unterminated quote and unclosed flow sequence
  between intact entries. `doc[1]::$["intact"]["child"]` and
  `doc[1]::$["also_intact"]["child"]` stay available.
